body.x: Mitsufuji participated in “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Unveiled” held on January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to introduce a wearable IoT product which monitors the user’s health, “Hamon”.

Mitsufuji is a company specialized in wearable IoT, and is the only company which provides one-stop solutions ranging from its own unique fiber to its cloud service. It produces various products including Hamon made of AGposs fiber which has superb conductibility so as to be good at antibiotic effect, deodorizing effect, heat effect, insulating effect, and anti-static effect. And such products of it can be adjusted per customers’ choice.

Wearing Hamon, you can monitor your ECG, the number of your heart pulses, the amount of your activities, etc. through elaborate data collected from biometric sensors contained in Hamon. As it can be connected to PCs, smartphones, or cloud, you can check your health wherever you are. It is equipped with a micro USB battery which can be easily charged.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
